title: 19 January 1961: Live: Alexandra Hall, Liverpool
content:
This was The Beatles’ only performance at Alexandra Hall on College Road, Crosby, Liverpool.

It was booked by Brian Kelly, who ran Beekay Promotions in a number of Liverpool venues including Litherland Town Hall, Alexandra Hall and the Aintree Institute. The Beatles performed at numerous Beekay shows in their early days.

Although The Beatles played there just once, Alexandra Hall hosted many bands. It has since been demolished.

Page last updated: 24 January 2024

  • 1978: Mixing: I’ve Had Enough by Wings
  • 1976: Recording: Silly Love Songs by Wings
  • 1973: Recording: Best Friend by Wings
  • 1971: Lawsuit to dissolve The Beatles’ partnership is heard in London’s High Court
  • 1967: Recording: A Day In The Life
  • 1964: The Beatles live: Olympia Theatre, Paris
  • 1963: The Beatles live: Town Hall Ballroom, Whitchurch, Shropshire
  • 1962: The Beatles live: Tower Ballroom, New Brighton, Wallasey
  • 1962: The Beatles live: Cavern Club, Liverpool (lunchtime)
